child_tool_info.instructions:
Align the supplied BV-BRC genomes to compare conserved regions, rearrangements and sequence correspondence. Assign the original genome_ids list, output_path and output_file to the GenomeAlignment AppService application. Preserve repeated input occurrences. Its native recipe choices are progressiveMauve and mauveAligner. Keep the selected recipe and numerical options unchanged; requested options, native manifest parameters and observed executable arguments are distinct facts. A declared recipe does not determine the acquired file's format. The retained service definition does not establish current deployment or that its default was used.

Commission the existing launch episode and its selected API child. api.bvbrc_appservice.prepare validates the chosen application definition, original parameters, input bindings and output destination without submitting. Select any needed Workspace preparation/transfer separately. submit performs the selected AppService.start_app2 call and retains its original task identity. Monitor with the resource's generic monitoring task and selected status/query_tasks or task_info observations. Preserve native states, timestamps and actual logs. An episode chooses further observations and repairs; these instructions supply no polling schedule, hidden retry, resource substitution or independent annotation-confidence score.

Use the existing results episode to acquire selected original-task outputs. task_info(job_result_id) supplies a UUID; workspace_metadata retrieves the actual job_result object's type/path. Select that receipt_row for its capability/download, then select exact manifest_member output indices for scientific files. Keep native receipt relationships and full bytes. A folder listing, matching basename or HTML report does not prove scientific format or immutable producing-run byte identity. If retained stdout is needed to extract observed command arguments, explicitly supply its actual task-info receipt as supplied_metadata and its native snapshot ContentBinding as supplied_contents. A receipt alone does not expose its log.

Select bvbrc_genome_alignment version 1 in the result selector. Its parameters contain analysis_id, document_slots and calculation_plan. Primary native formats are mauve_v4 (declared version null or 4) and mauve1_xmfa (null or Mauve1); mode is null. The XMFA reader uses dialect mauve1 and DNA. Sidecar readers are mauve_backbone/libmems_signed_coordinate_pairs_v1 and mauve_bbcols/libmems_interval_columns_members_v1, with null declared version/mode. Select roles genome_alignment_primary, genome_alignment_backbone or genome_alignment_bbcols explicitly. Visualization JSON is not an alignment matrix. Do not join BBCols interval numbers to exported XMFA blocks without actual mapping evidence. Mauve1 member numbers are one-based; v4/sidecar member indices are zero-based.

Request the exact calculations needed: v4 segment correspondence/coverage, backbone coverage, BBCols column unions, XMFA alignment counts, XMFA coverage, forward coordinates or inverse coordinates. Preserve selection populations, overlap and gap/ambiguity policies. Native declared lengths differ from authenticated original source lengths. Original-source coverage and feature coordinates require actual source and transformation evidence; a current refetch cannot prove historical staged bytes. Missing denominators stay missing. Native parsers and metadata extractors populate the numerical sheet; separate deterministic calculators use that sheet and explicit parameters without acquisition, new jobs or model calls. Retain full native outputs, sheet and calculated components. Recalculate saved data with changed parameters without rewriting historical observations.

Use requested_form_schema's finite selectors for numerical measurements, v4 segments, backbone spans, BBCols intervals, coverage intervals, XMFA native/source/original/inverse coordinates, request status, requirements and qualifications. The corresponding twelve bvbrc_genome_alignment return sources pass only the parent's requested fields through the existing typed boundary. Keep measured zero, missing, incompatible, partial and unavailable distinct. Alignment identity and coverage are measurements, not calibrated gene-function probabilities. This API route does not claim local/HPC deployment or a verified live service execution.

completed_actions.description: Completed own actions at this child's level; an investigation commissioned by it counts once.

continuation_cost.description: The actual child's decision threshold in its configured controller units.

alpha.description: Original band parameter: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; otherwise the configured tail parameter.

lower.description: The original band's lower coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

status_code.description: 0 normal; -1 insufficient observations; -2 unidentifiable. Coded coordinates are not negative forecasts.

uncertainty_code.description: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; 1 Chebyshev; 2 Laplace approximation. The code does not establish calibrated coverage.

upper.description: The original band's upper coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

value.description: The original band point in this child's configured controller units.

stop_requested.description: The child's controller decision, not a parent instruction, job cancellation or scientific completion.

adaptations: Real marginal credit responses pass into the fit without integer coercion
Completed Episode acquisitions condition on observation; no failure/usability model
A fresh original fitter cold-fits the entire score history each turn
Original numeric bands and delta/Laplace curvature approximation are retained
Signed corrections use paired gain/loss marks at the same action ranks inside the estimator
After an observed loss, component alpha/2 bands subtract to an approximate signed net interval
limitations: The fractional kernel is not a continuous-response probability density
Uncertainty assumes the working model and is not coverage calibrated
Credit units affect effective information and must remain fixed within an Episode
Rank-decay extrapolation assumes declining yield; late discoveries can violate it
No failed-attempt probability is estimated from completed-only acquisitions
The inherited local optimizer has no global optimum or convergence certificate; bands can jump across history lengths
Before any observed loss the original nonnegative model assumes zero loss; this is an explicit working-model assumption
Gain/loss interval subtraction is not coverage calibrated; Bonferroni allocation cannot calibrate the underlying Laplace approximation
